reasoning_summary: The actual PowerPoint render preserves the design's hierarchy, content and declared editable structure.
observations: The three-line Bodoni headline, four numbered ledger rows and small notebook caption keep the target's editorial reading order.
The measurement search windows follow the visible ink independently of the logical native text boxes. Adjacent title descenders are no longer misassigned to the next line.
The notebook photograph and tall archive collage retain their original regional pixels. Ledger labels, questions, rules and the title remain native.
remaining_fidelity_limits: Bodoni 72 and Arial are available-font interpretations of generated lettering. Exact glyph outlines differ.
Fine grain outside the regional artwork is represented by a sampled native background. Photographs and intrinsic depicted marks remain raster.
review_environment: LibreOffice on macOS with run-local discovery of installed system fonts
